svg.title: What the location feature measures
svg.desc: Two 20-bar candle charts. Left: a downtrend where the red signal candle closes at the bottom of the 20-bar range, location near 0. Right: an uptrend where the red signal candle is a small dip near the top of the range, location near 0.8.
svg.text: Signal (circled) closes 2% of the way up
Signal (circled) closes 84% of the way up
